scope: Candid removal-only scene, official black EVA artwork and optical bloom

product.configuration: Bare device without an attached collection tube, as shown in the reference photograph.
product.accuracy: Recognizable generative interpretation, with slightly taller/narrower housing than the official photograph. Not exact CAD or filmed product footage.

logo.application: Original PNG alpha, recolored black and tracked onto the pouch; no replacement font

generation.rejection: Wrong letterforms and pink cast; excluded from active scene.

assembly.workflow: Higgsfield remote sandbox: trim, crop, OpenCV tracked logo replacement, RGB highlight bloom, H264 encoding
assembly.tracking: Reference-to-frame optical flow with RANSAC homography; 96 frames, minimum 143 inliers
assembly.printRemoval: Local text mask, dilated 3x3; Telea inpainting radius4
assembly.effects: RGB highlight extraction .45, Gaussian sigma14, screen opacity .40, diffusion .7 mixed16%
assembly.posterNote: Responsive stills derived from the final720px video;1000px is an upscaled display derivative.

findings: Twelve evenly spaced final frames inspected for motion continuity, logo tracking and print removal.
Source range contains only reach/removal from the already-open pouch; no opening, closing or reverse playback.
Official sans-serif letterforms remain black and attached to the white pouch.
No tagline remains; lower halftone clouds retained.
Final device remains small with coral actuator, ivory shell and short connector; scene stays warm with soft optical bloom.
limits: Generated editorial scene and proposed packaging; not filmed product footage or exact CAD.
The device interpretation remains slightly narrower than the official packshot.
